params.rho_label_convention: rho at row N means r_N / r_(N/2)
params.delta_definition: direct numpy sum over primes[N:2N] of p^(-sigma)*(cos(t log p) - i sin(t log p))

constants.band_coincidence_note: ADD and SQRT bands coincide at sigma=0.5 because the additive law a=1-sigma also gives a=1/2 there; sigma=0 is the discriminating row
